base_policy_note.String: VersionedProjectPolicy: base damage is 100 times released HardLevelGroup 1 HPRatio at the selected enemy's own immutable level, then multiplied by one plus the immutable battle contribution's Protocol maximum-HP increase. Use checked fixed-point multiplication, flooring to six fractional places after each multiplication; the shared final TrueDamage operation floors to integral damage. The source contains FixedValues 100 and a HPRatio read but does not establish this group, the opaque difficulty-query mapping, operator order or rounding. Group 1, Protocol HP scaling and these multiplication boundaries are independent low-confidence policies, not decoded postfix or observed parity.

base_replacement_condition.String: Preserves known enemy-level and Threshold-Protocol dependence without substituting owner ATK, zero or an arbitrary level polynomial. Alternatives include other released HardLevelGroups, a Protocol-specific scaling field, additive difficulty or a different postfix order. Replace each field when released typed operands or reproducible current observations establish it. Data fixtures cover all 95 levels, canonical precision, missing/duplicate/foreign rows and provenance; native base-expression and both-family equipment tests are still required. Callback, ATK, Forge, replay and terminal runtime admission remain pending.

source_semantics.String: Released structure: character-create Path filtering, a Replace AttackAddedRatio modifier, attack-start reset, hit-target marks and zero-current-HP damage observation, distinct death/deathrattle conversion callbacks, marked-current-HP maximum retarget with random ties, TrueDamage/ByBaseDamage conversion, then accumulator and mark cleanup. Attack-end clears During_Attack. No postfix decoding is inferred from opcode bytes or numeric hashes.

summary_en.String: Erudition and Hunt characters gain 80% ATK. Attack-kill overflow converts into True damage of ten times base damage plus the overflow, aimed at the highest-current-HP attacked enemy.

summary_zh_cn.String: 智识和巡猎角色攻击力提高80%。攻击消灭敌人后的溢出值转化为10倍基础伤害加溢出值的真实伤害，目标为已攻击敌人中当前生命值最高者。

unresolved_runtime.String: Unimplemented: native death/deathrattle callback correspondence, hit/attack observation ordering, accumulator expression decoding, linked-actor ownership, tied-target labeled RNG and last-kill behavior. The base-DMG expression reads HPRatio, an opaque difficulty query and unresolved postfix operands; its exact level/difficulty formula is not established. Do not substitute character ATK, a constant or zero and claim parity. Replace each uncertainty with released typed semantics or a separately reviewed deterministic VersionedProjectPolicy preserving the known constraints. Bounded public cross-check on 2026-10-03: https://honkai-star-rail.fandom.com/wiki/Parallel_Universe_Walkie-Talkie corroborates current Arcadian Chronicles terms and level/Threshold-Protocol dependence, not the hidden formula. Ordinary/Cyclical consumer, Forge, replay and terminal coverage remain pending.
